page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.2xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro system. The instance features an arm64 AWS Graviton processor operating at 3.3 GHz, delivering 8 dedicated physical cores across 8 vCPUs with a single thread per core. Memory capacity is provisioned at 64.0 GB, yielding a high-density allocation of 8.0 GB per core. No GPU acceleration is present on this hardware configuration.

Local storage is provided via a 474 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, granting direct, high-throughput, low-latency block storage. Baseline networking throughput is configured for 4 Gbps over the Nitro hypervisor architecture. The instance lacks bundled public IPv4 addresses, relying on standard private networking configurations.

The balance of 8 dedicated ARM cores, 64.0 GB of memory, and fast local NVMe SSD storage makes the r9gd.2xlarge resource-efficient for memory-heavy applications requiring fast temporary storage. Ideal workloads include in-memory caches, distributed key-value stores, real-time analytics engines, ETL pipelines, and high-performance databases requiring fast scratch space.
